description: Synthetic sesslint.adapters.drift parity (DriftTracker state and flush modes before finding fingerprint).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-drift-finding-fingerprint: into_findings on a non-empty transition buffer calls make_finding, which needs sesslint.determinism.canonical_json_bytes. Rust stops at the missing fingerprint codec. Vectors compare tracker state and empty or suppressed flush only, not Python Finding objects.
